{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print('Unique severity values:', df['severity'].unique())
print('Number of unique patient_id values:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Number of total rows:', len(df))
print('Number of duplicate patient_id values:', df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Confirm that sample_seq can be used to deduplicate (max sample_seq per patient)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check that deduplication reduced row count by exactly the number of re-tests
num_retests = len(df) - len(df_dedup)
print('Number of re-tested patients (rows removed):', num_retests)

# Now compute the fraction with severe baseline disease in the deduplicated population
def compute_fraction_severe(df_dedup):
    return df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).get('severe', 0)

fraction_severe = compute_fraction_severe(df_dedup)
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}')

# Return the fraction
fraction_severe"}
